augmentation_policy: Band positions are not shifted. Augmentation only modifies intensity response, band-envelope intensity, residual baseline, Gaussian read-noise-like perturbations, symmetric broadening, and weak-band attenuation.

augmentation_protocol.scope: training split only; validation and test spectra are never augmented
augmentation_protocol.physical_principle: Raman band centers are not translated because band positions are diagnostic for a mineral phase.

band_detection.signal: baseline-corrected, max-normalized intensity within the valid spectral range
band_detection.fallback: if scipy.signal.find_peaks is unavailable, local maxima satisfying the same height threshold are used

constraints: no wavenumber-axis translation or interpolation jitter is applied during augmentation
negative intensities are clipped to zero after perturbation
each augmented spectrum is renormalized to unit maximum within the valid range
